Key highlights from the management commentary ◼ Standalone auto PBIT margin improved QoQ to 9.8% from 8.9%, supported by ~5% price hikes, mix improvement, hedging and cost actions despite sharp steel, copper and rubber inflation. ◼ M&M retained mid-to-high teens FY27 SUV growth guidance, with Scorpio at full capacity and waiting periods across the portfolio.
